name: grimorio
description: Grimorio - Catalogatore e Gestore Collezioni Magic: The Gathering

scripts.build: node -e "const fs = require('fs'); const path = require('path'); const dist = path.join(process.cwd(), 'dist'); if (!fs.existsSync(dist)) fs.mkdirSync(dist); fs.copyFileSync('index.html', path.join(dist, 'index.html')); if (fs.existsSync('favicon.ico')) fs.copyFileSync('favicon.ico', path.join(dist, 'favicon.ico')); if (fs.existsSync('favicon.png')) fs.copyFileSync('favicon.png', path.join(dist, 'favicon.png')); if (fs.existsSync('_headers')) fs.copyFileSync('_headers', path.join(dist, '_headers')); console.log('✓ Cartella dist pronta!');"
scripts.deploy: npm run build && npx wrangler pages deploy dist
